metrics.profile_summary: Experienced marketing and communications professional with a strong background in brand management across Pakistan and MENA regions. Expert in strategic planning, multi-million dollar budget optimization, and leading cross-functional teams to drive market share.

education.degree: Bachelor of Media Sciences (Majors in Advertising)

experience.role: Brand Manager | Social Media & Traditional Marketing
experience.description: Leads brand portfolios in Pakistan and MENA, executing product launches and market expansion while managing multi-million dollar budgets to maximize ROI.
Managed interdepartmental and external communications, ensured brand messaging consistency, and led employee wellbeing initiatives.
Executed ATL and BTL marketing campaigns, tracked brand sales performance, and collaborated with creative teams for content production.
Managed marketing and communication strategies for a diverse client portfolio including PepsiCo, Spontex, and ICI Pakistan.

strengths: Proven experience managing multi-million dollar budgets
Direct people management experience as Team Lead
weaknesses: Total professional experience (~4-5 years) is slightly below the 5-7 year requirement
No explicit mention of GA4 or specific ad platform reporting tools
evaluation.summary: Hijab is a highly compatible local candidate with the required leadership experience and a strong track record in brand management. While she falls slightly short of the total years of experience and lacks explicit GA4 keywords, her Google Digital Marketing certification and budget management skills make her a top contender.
